description: Utility helper functions for reading, extracting, and formatting Credits values from API responses within a frontend project. The functions handle safe extraction with fallback strategies and locale-aware number formatting.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extract credits used from a details response, with fallback to camelCase and snake_case fields, and handle nested data. Returns null if no valid number is found.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Format a numeric credits value into a locale-aware string with appropriate decimal precision, or return a placeholder if input is invalid.
